# Your app was down for ten minutes. Did you lose the payment webhook?

> Never lose a Stripe, GitHub or Shopify webhook because your app was down. Self-hosted relay that verifies signatures, saves events before answering, retries with backoff and replays on demand. Free, MIT, zero dependencies.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
